prompt_text: Generate a video of a feminine-presenting adult aged 40-49 with tan skin and a slim build, wearing a short-sleeved shirt and pants. A healed, small, full-color watercolor tattoo depicting fern is located on the outer forearm. The subject is sitting and gently moves the tattooed limb in a studio with a simple background under dim lighting. Capture a medium front view with focus primarily on the overall subject. Let a hand briefly overlap a small edge of the tattoo, leaving most of the design visible and identifiable. Keep clothing clear of the design, orient the tattooed surface toward the camera, and retain enough detail for tattoo recognition even in dim or full-body views.
